protocol.acceptance: May/July/September full net capital month arithmetic mean at least10%; all May-September months nonnegative and full coverage. No month-specific fitting or extra future observation period gate. Exposed historical data remain development regression.
protocol.capital: Original settled-cash rule, allocation0/1 only; at most one ETF, no leverage, same-day reentry forbidden, T+1 and available dividend cash handled normally. V25 full-cash/dividend wait rule is not applied. All fees/slippage, dividends/splits, cross-month MTM and unknown-held occupation retained. Cash0 does not meet growth objective.

protocol.state_filter: Bayesian online change-point run-length distribution, initialP(r0=0)=1, constant hazard1/63. Three conditionally independent Normal-Inverse-Gamma observation heads,prior mean0,kappa1,alpha2,beta2. Student-t predictive df2alpha and scale^2=beta*(kappa+1)/(alpha*kappa). At every new x, multiply each previous run probability by its predictive likelihood; send hazard mass to run0 and remaining mass to run+1; normalize in logspace. Update each growth sufficient statistic and insert fresh prior at run0. No posterior truncation and no backward smoothing. Correlation/autocorrelation of coordinates and the geometric duration prior are modeling assumptions, not verified market laws. P(run0) equalsconstant hazard and is notinterpreted as a changealarm; reportP(run<5) and expectedrunlength as diagnostics only,notbullishprobabilities.
protocol.error_model: Same as v27 two-score Ridge20 residual model: same-clock latest120/min60 original forecasts with both policy terminal outcomes known beforeday00ET, chronological completeprefix,expiredprefix disablesclock. At querytime each parentdate age=a in officialstate observations receives membershipP(current_run>=a+1), then multiplier.25+.75*membership on original63parent half-life. Normalize weights sumN to holdregularization constant;Kish effectiveparents>=30 elseabstain. At least20complete stateobservations. Pairedoutputactualnetlogreturns minusoriginalrawscores. Weightedpopulation scale and intercept, alpha20 unchanged. Filter changes weights atcurrentclock, so do notcallfit midnight-trained. Require sum of current-regime memberships across mature source dates >=10; this is expected membership mass,notindependent sample size. Otherwiseabstain rather than normalizing a uniform.25 old-regime floor into false confidence. Fixedprior control uses itsownexpectedmembership andsame rule. This numerical support requirement is a preregistered research assumption,not a proven safety guarantee.
